newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index little changed.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index little changed.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange on Thursday closed little changed in higher volume, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 611.83 from 611.99 on Wednesday.
Trade volume was 1.291 million dinars against 888,493 dinars.
Retail stores Monoprix was down 1.44 dinar to 46.56 dinars. Banque de Tunisie down 1.55 dinar to 77 dinars.
Investment fund SPDIT was up 1.26 dinar to 41.88 dinars. Banque Nationale Agricole up 0.95 dinar to 31.67 dinars.
